generation_note: Fingerprints computed from project PDF pages after grayscale conversion, automatic dark-content bounding-box crop with 2% padding, resize to 17x16, and 256 horizontal adjacent-pixel comparisons. They are for cross-witness page identity testing, not textual validation.
epistemic_note: The local PDF page-to-printed-page mapping was established by AI visual collation. Perceptual fingerprints provide a reproducible machine test for matching an external IIIF witness to that already-collated sequence.
